```
module library.names
  purpose: Helpers for working with people's names.

public function initials(name: Text)
  returns Text
  purpose: Return the upper-cased first letters of each word in a full name, with nothing between them. Blank or extra spaces are ignored.
  tags: text, names
  example: initials("ada marie lovelace") is "AML"
  example: initials("  grace   hopper ") is "GH"
  example: initials("plato") is "P"
  example: initials("") is ""
  example: initials("   ") is ""

  let letters be
    for each word in name.split(" ")
    where not word.is_empty()
    collect word.take(1).to_upper()
  return letters.join("")
end

test "every word contributes its initial"
  check initials("ada marie lovelace") is "AML"
end

test "extra spaces are ignored"
  check initials("  grace   hopper ") is "GH"
end

test "a blank name has no initials"
  check initials("   ") is ""
end
```

```
module library.names
  purpose: Helpers for working with people's names.

public function initials(self: Text)
  returns Text
  purpose: Return the upper-cased first letters of each word in a full name, with nothing between them. Blank or extra spaces are ignored.
  tags: text, names
  example: "ada marie lovelace".initials() is "AML"
  example: "  ada   lovelace ".initials() is "AL"
  example: "grace".initials() is "G"
  example: "   ".initials() is ""

  let letters be
    for each part in self.split(" ")
    where not part.is_empty()
    collect part.take(1).to_upper()
  return letters.join("")
end

test "initials of a three part name"
  check "ada marie lovelace".initials() is "AML"
end

test "extra spaces are ignored"
  check "  alan    mathison   turing  ".initials() is "AMT"
end

test "a blank name has no initials"
  check "".initials() is ""
end
```
